info.title: SHAPI advisory stripe-endive-checkout-session-payment-method-types-removed
info.summary: Stripe 2026-09-30.endive removes payment_method_types from Checkout Session creation

workflows.summary: Shows the change: From API version 2026-09-30.endive, creating a Checkout Session with payment_method_types returns a 400 error. Stripe replaces it with dynamic payment methods, excluded_payment_method_types, or the new allowed_payment_method_types, which filters out incompatible types instead of failing.

steps.description: POST /v1/checkout/sessions succeeds, with the changed response the advisory describes (required-field)
